8 foot (99” long x 46” wide) sailing pram for sale! Fantastic multi-use boat that rows like a dream and sails well also! Less than 80 pounds, it is easily carried and can be transported on top of a car. Can take up to 2.5 HP outbound engine, if you desire. Great tool to teach or learn sailing, launch at local beaches for crabbing, or simply enjoy a good row.

This boat lived most of its life as a tender to a cruising sailboat. It is well loved / used, but perfectly functional; no leaks or major repairs needed. Use as-is, or make it a fun project to restore cosmetics to like-new condition.

The boat includes set of oars, mast and boom, rudder and tiller, daggerboard, battened sail in like-new condition, and two new Harken blocks for good measure. It will need new running rigging (control lines for the sail).

Price is firm and new owner will need to transport. Happy to help load.

Get out and enjoy the tail end of summer and beautiful early fall on the Salish Sea!
